source_scope.time_bin: source-native monthly Period P1 through P12 within each Site
source_scope.partner_id: source-native Insect_Best_ID after whitespace normalization only
source_scope.interaction_value: one quantitative interaction event per source row with nonmissing Plant_Best_ID and Insect_Best_ID; repeated rows count as repeated interaction events, matching the deposited R code table(Plant_Best_ID, Insect_Best_ID)
source_scope.zero_rule: partners absent from an observed Site x Period receive structural zeros in the common analyzer; no missing Site x Period is invented or split
source_scope.bird_data: excluded from the primary natural-regime matrix because the deposited analysis reduces birds to binary site-by-bi-period structure

effort_contract.source_design: each garden site was sampled monthly for 12 months by the same observer using a 150 m transect and 60 minutes of insect interaction observation per Site x Period
effort_contract.reason: equal by source design; the common analyzer therefore uses interaction events per 60 minutes and no outcome-dependent normalization

structural_admission_rule.decision_timing: apply only after the frozen adapter reconstructs the canonical Site x Period x Insect_Best_ID event table and before any D1 or phi is computed

prohibited_after_freeze: replace monthly P1-P12 bins with six bi-periods for the primary analysis
drop or merge a site based on D1 or phi
change Insect_Best_ID to a coarser or finer taxonomic identity after coordinates are seen
use floral abundance or reproductive outcomes to admit, exclude or weight a system
include bird interactions in the monthly quantitative primary matrix
change the equal 60-minute effort contract after coordinate inspection
select only months or taxa that widen the natural regime plane
claim_boundary: Martinique is admitted, system by system, only from pre-coordinate source structure: stable Site identity, source-native monthly Periods, stable insect identities, event-count interactions and equal sampling effort. Coordinate computation is forbidden until this record and its adapter are committed.
